snippet.title: Rose of Dragontail Gameplay Trailer Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Coming 2027 to Steam and itch.io
https://ioribranford.com/dragontail

Kick tail with tail! Enjoy blazing-fast beat-em-up action as Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero. Kick, slam, tail slap, tackle, pile drive, spit fire, and throw whatever and whoever you get your claws on to a groovy surf rock soundtrack.

#beatemup #hackandslash #indiegame
